title: Free Entry, $10K Trading Tournament — Now Open to API Traders
author: Junior-City
selftext:
After suggestions from this community, we’re opening up the **$10K tournament to API traders as well.**

Link up your agents, bots, or trading systems, connect through the Kairos APIs, and compete.

We also want this to be a place where people can share strategies, workflows, ideas, and feedback around API trading and AI agents. The goal is not just to run a competition, but to learn what actually works, what breaks, and what infrastructure API traders need.

Please give us as much feedback as possible throughout the tournament. Push the APIs, build interesting systems, share what you learn, and help us make Kairos better for API traders.

Hopefully by the end of this, we all have a much better understanding of what works and what doesn’t when building AI-powered trading systems. I also want to learn what kind of trades through our system help traders, what type of trades are harmful and do not really enable net new behavior. It's going to be pretty easy, and added a section with team for consistency/volume so if folks are trading a ton you will get rewards.

  
Docs are here: [docs.kairos.trade](http://docs.kairos.trade) 

Please give us feedback across anything we do!

comments.author: Junior-City
comments.body: Focus on this is to ensure kairos trade is the best infrastructure required for anyone trading, and so look forward having you test our systems using trading agents.
